title: Digital Pinball
overview: Fast, smooth and utterly addictive, this is pinball for the connoisseur. Bumpers, flippers, targets, ramps, pits, flashing lights, bonuses galore, manic multi-ball and more are all packed into four completely individual themed tables and combine with the unique isometric 3D viewing angles, thumping rock tunes and tension-building digitised speech and cut screens throughout to bring you the most realistic computerised pinball game ever made.
